flows.representativeInput: status.mjs --root <fixture> with feature-folder .log receipts and report-cited receipts (status.mjs:91-117 at c847ec4)
flows.expected: With 3 receipts, 2 loaded:true, the feature row carries load = "2 of 3 test runs started above the core count (<cores> cores). Cap workers per run with the runner's own flag; see setup." One line; a receipt cited twice counts once.

observations.actual: [AC:spec-10-1] passes (2/2 tests, exit 0): 3 receipts (2 in the feature folder, 1 outside cited by two reports and also re-citing a folder receipt) give exactly the spec sentence with "2 of 3" and "(14 cores)".

Probe via the CLI: 3 folder receipts, 2 loaded, cores 8 give the exact sentence "2 of 3 ... (8 cores) ..."; it contains no newline and names numbers. A receipt written by the real payload evidence runner is read (on this machine it was loaded: "1 of 1 ... (14 cores)"). A "./"-prefixed citation of a folder receipt counts once; missing, ../ and absolute citations are ignored without a crash; malformed footer JSON and a footer that is not the last line are not counted. Status writes no file (git status --porcelain --ignored unchanged).

flows.representativeInput: status.mjs --root <fixture> with only loaded:false/null receipts, and with footerless old receipts
flows.expected: No load field and no other change in the output.

observations.actual: [AC:spec-10-2] passes: loaded:false plus loaded:null receipts, and two footerless receipts, each give a feature row without a load property.

Probe: the feature row with two footerless receipts and one loaded:false receipt is byte-identical (JSON) to the row with no receipts at all. With one footerless and one loaded receipt, the footerless one is not counted in m ("1 of 1").

findings.summary: When a loaded footer has no integer cores, the line prints "(0 cores)" (probe INFO line). evidence.mjs always writes cores, so only a hand-made or foreign footer hits it; consider omitting the parenthesis or skipping such footers.
findings.assumption: Footers come from evidence.mjs, which always records cores; the spec does not decide this case.

findings.summary: When loaded receipts come from machines with different core counts the line names the largest one. The spec names one <cores> value and does not decide mixed machines.
findings.assumption: One machine per feature queue is the usual case.

findings.summary: m counts only receipts with a valid footer, not every .log; old footerless receipts and non-test logs are excluded. This matches the spec check (3 footered receipts) and is the reading closest to the brief (a number about runs whose load is known).
findings.assumption: A footerless receipt is not a known test run for load purposes.

limits: Installed .joycraft/runtime/evidence.mjs is older than the payload copy, so this review's own receipts carry no joycraft-evidence footer; the payload status.mjs and evidence.mjs were reviewed and exercised.
Output of status.mjs is JSON; the "line" is the per-feature load string field. No human-text rendering exists to check.
Test changes: spec says none; the commit adds only a new test file (tests/runtime-status-load.test.ts) and changes no existing test file.
